# AJH Digital

> AJH Digital helps businesses, churches, ministries, organizations, entrepreneurs, and professionals build and maintain effective digital experiences.

## Primary Website

https://ajhdigital.com/

## About AJH Digital

AJH Digital provides website design and development, hosting and website care, copywriting, content strategy, content-level SEO, social media content, digital strategy, and online presence and technology consulting. Personal service, clear scope, and human review guide the work.

## Services

- Small Business Websites: professionally designed standard small business websites with hosting and ongoing management. Essential starts at $199 one-time setup plus $49/month; Simple Start starts at $0 setup plus $99/month. No long-term contract; cancel anytime. Custom functionality, advanced integrations, e-commerce, booking systems, extensive development and third-party services are quoted separately based on project requirements.

- Church & Ministry Websites: professionally managed church websites with hosting, maintenance, and routine content updates. Essential starts at $99 setup plus $25/month; Simple Start starts at $0 setup plus $49/month. Both offer the same standard service, with no long-term contract. Custom work and premium third-party services require separate approval and pricing.
- Website Content Refresh: improve existing website messaging, readability, calls to action, and content-level SEO. Starts at $99 for up to five pages, plus $55 per additional page through ten total pages. More than ten pages requires a custom quote. This is content work, not a website redesign or development package.
- Custom websites: new builds, redesigns, landing pages, mobile-responsive websites, forms, integrations, hosting, and website care. Custom website pricing starts at $999 setup plus $149/month, subject to scope.
- Content: copywriting, website copy, brand messaging, storytelling, communication strategy, blog and article content, and content management.
- Content-level SEO: page titles and descriptions, internal linking, content planning, and search-friendly content structure. Search rankings are not guaranteed.
- Digital services: social media content, digital strategy, online presence consulting, and technology consulting.

Displayed prices are starting prices for the stated package or scope, not guarantees for every project. Pricing may increase or decrease depending on project scope, website size, complexity, integrations, third-party services, custom development, content needs, maintenance, and other project-specific requirements. The current service page and an agreed project quote govern the actual work and price.
